business_summary: The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. engages in the provision of various banking products and services to individual and corporate customers in Japan. It offers deposits, loans, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, buying and selling of government bonds, agency services, etc. It also provides investment advisory services. The company was formerly known as Kiyo Bank Co., Ltd. and changed its name to The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. in October 2013. The Kiyo Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1895 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Kiyo Bank, Ltd.는 일본의 개인 및 기업 고객에게 다양한 은행 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 예금, 대출, 증권투자, 국내외환, 외국환, 국채 매매, 대행 서비스 등을 제공하며, 투자자문 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Kiyo Bank Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2013년 10월에 Kiyo Bank, Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Kiyo Bank, Ltd.는 1895년에 설립되었으며 일본 와카야마에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
